extra_courses.description: Develops programs that run multiple tasks concurrently and explains how to coordinate their work correctly and efficiently.

extra_courses.title: Digital Design and Computer Architecture

extra_courses.title: Probability and Statistics
extra_courses.description: Develops probability and statistical inference for describing uncertainty and drawing conclusions from data.

extra_courses.title: Computer Networks
extra_courses.description: Explains how computers exchange data across networks, from addressing and routing to transport protocols.

extra_courses.title: Data Modelling and Databases
extra_courses.description: Covers structured data models, relational queries and the principles of database systems.

extra_courses.title: Formal Methods and Functional Programming
extra_courses.description: Uses functional programming, specifications and formal reasoning to describe and check software behavior.

extra_courses.title: General Chemistry (Inorganic Chemistry) II
extra_courses.description: Continues general inorganic chemistry through the behavior, bonding and reactions of inorganic substances.

extra_courses.title: General Chemistry (Organic Chemistry) II
extra_courses.description: Continues general organic chemistry and connects molecular structure to recognizable families of organic reactions.

extra_courses.title: Physical Chemistry I: Thermodynamics
extra_courses.description: Uses the laws of thermodynamics to explain equilibrium and energy changes in chemical systems.

extra_courses.title: Physics II
extra_courses.description: Continues the introductory physics sequence for chemical sciences students.

extra_courses.title: Mathematical Foundations I: Analysis B
extra_courses.description: Continues the analysis sequence with calculus techniques used in the chemical sciences.

extra_courses.title: Mathematical Foundations II: Linear Algebra and Statistics
extra_courses.description: Introduces linear algebra and statistical tools for interpreting data and modeling chemical systems.

extra_courses.title: Inorganic and Organic Chemistry I
extra_courses.description: Develops practical laboratory skills through work with inorganic and organic compounds.

extra_courses.title: Inorganic Chemistry II
extra_courses.description: Continues the study of inorganic compounds, with emphasis on the relationship between structure, properties and reactivity.

extra_courses.title: Organic Chemistry II
extra_courses.description: Extends the organic chemistry sequence through more complex reaction mechanisms and synthesis problems.

extra_courses.title: Physical Chemistry III: Molecular Quantum Mechanics
extra_courses.description: Applies quantum mechanics to explain molecular structure, electronic states and spectra.

extra_courses.title: Biochemistry
extra_courses.description: Introduces the molecules and reactions that make up living systems, including proteins, enzymes and metabolism.

extra_courses.title: Analytical Chemistry II
extra_courses.description: Continues analytical chemistry with methods for identifying and measuring the constituents of chemical samples.

extra_courses.title: Chemical Engineering
extra_courses.description: Introduces the engineering principles used to describe and design industrial chemical processes.

extra_courses.title: Physical and Analytical Chemistry
extra_courses.description: Combines laboratory work in physical chemistry with techniques for making and evaluating analytical measurements.

extra_courses.title: Industrial Chemistry
extra_courses.description: Examines how chemical transformations are organized into industrial production processes.

extra_courses.title: Heterogeneous Reaction Engineering
extra_courses.description: Studies how rates, transport and contact between phases affect the design of reactors with heterogeneous reactions.

extra_courses.title: Separation Process Technology
extra_courses.description: Introduces equipment and process concepts for separating mixtures into useful fractions.

extra_courses.title: Chemical Process Control
extra_courses.description: Applies feedback and dynamic modeling to the control of chemical processes.

extra_courses.title: Safety, Environmental Assessment and Risk Analysis
extra_courses.description: Covers methods for identifying process hazards and assessing environmental effects and risks.

extra_courses.title: Modelling and Mathematical Methods in Process and Chemical Engineering
extra_courses.description: Develops modeling and mathematical tools for analyzing problems in chemical and process engineering.

extra_courses.title: Case Studies in Process Design II
extra_courses.description: Applies chemical engineering principles to integrated process design cases.
